Ahmedabad Fire Chief and Aide Arrested for Bribery

Ahmedabad's Chief Fire Officer and an intermediary were arrested for allegedly accepting a bribe of Rs 36,000. The money was reportedly taken to clear No Objection Certificates (NOCs) related to fire safety. The arrests were made by the Anti-Corruption Bureau.
